mainText: Man City owners should be forced to sell, say clubs. Manchester City's owners must be forced to sell the club as punishment for breaking financial rules, senior figures at some Premier League clubs tell BBC Sport. Is it time to sell Haaland? - FPL gameweek 12 dilemmas. BBC Sport's Fantasy Premier League expert Holly Shand gives her answers to some of the biggest dilemmas facing managers in gameweek 12. Clashes mar European games as Macron condemns violence. Violent clashes mar a number of European football matches on Thursday night, with French president Emmanuel Macron condemning trouble at Marseille's home game against Levski Sofia.

titleText: Other news you might find interesting
mainText: Zelensky criticises 'strange' Trump-Putin friendship in BBC interview. Ukraine's president voices frustration with US and says it is not pushing Russia hard enough in peace talks to end the war. John Simpson: Ukraine is bowed but still unbroken as freezing weather sets in. Ukraine settles in for another devastating winter as the questions persists: how will it all end? Catherine joins cancer support group in new documentary. The documentary features her personal thoughts on her illness and recovery, following her cancer diagnosis. 'I wouldn't be here today without you': Student's praise for man who stopped Huntingdon train attacker. Astrid credits Stephen Crean with saving her life during the Huntingdon train attack last year.
